newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Electronic Data lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Electronic Data lowered.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities said it downgraded Electronic Data Systems Corp to market performer from buy, citing disappointing fourth quarter earnings reported Thursday.

-- "We believe that the company has not yet sufficiently addressed investors' concerns including questions about near-term earnings potential, continued margin pressure, potential Year 2000 liabilities and the prospects for winning new mega-contracts," a J.P. Morgan report said.
